context_requirements: Expression of the specific anthelmintic drug target (e.g., nematode-specific tubulin, glutamate-gated chloride channels, or beta-tubulin) in human cells
Intact drug uptake and intracellular activation pathways
Lack of rapid efflux or metabolic inactivation
falsifiers: Consistent, dose-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h across multiple cell lines
Enrichment of a specific transcriptional signature (e.g., tubulin-related or stress-response genes) that is reproducible and not attributable to vehicle
Clear differential sensitivity among the nine cell lines that correlates with expression of a known anthelmintic target
